title: HSWall 솔로 #007 · 레전드바스트 · Chinese Cizhou sgraffito ceramic · 철판 벽 직접 고정 · white glossy lips
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a steel vault cell with a wall of riveted dark iron plates behind her, a low steel ceiling, caged industrial lamps glowing on the wall, old iron tools hanging on the wall, a steel grate floor, dark and moody lamplight, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus from head to toe, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Subject: ONE real adult Japanese woman in her early 30s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, deeply sun-tanned bronze makeup over real skin, bold white eyeshadow across the lids, white glossy lips, a bright turquoise liner accent at the outer corners, long lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a faintly overwhelmed look, her eyes damp and her breath caught in slightly parted lips, deep reddish mahogany-brown hair styled in countless fine micro braids, real living eyes. Long square nails, matte finish.

Physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her upper body so wide. A mythologically, legendarily enormous bust dominates her entire silhouette, resting heavy and full, far wider than her own shoulders and projecting well forward of the rest of her body — the single defining feature of her frame, every other curve secondary to it. Below it a waistline still draws in with a visible inward pull, round hips and soft thighs continue her curves. Her head looks small in comparison to her massive bust. The bust is unmistakably, overwhelmingly the dominant feature. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Skin: Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a smooth taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds, faint stretch marks where the great curves have expanded. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Chinese Cizhou sgraffito ceramic — a glossy jet-black glaze carved to cream-white peony scrolls, wide carved cream bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense leaf scrolls filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her body below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line. The paint has worn thin in broad patches over her upper back, hips and calves and chipped off in small flakes at her wrists and ankles, the living skin showing through the faded pattern. A grey film of dust and soot dulls her face, her mascara is smeared under her eyes, grime is rubbed into her shoulders, forearms and thighs, and her bare feet and toes are black with grime.

Restraints: Her wrists wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ring fixed directly onto a heavy iron plate bolted flat to the riveted iron wall high above her head on its own side, a little wider apart than her shoulders, the cuffs sitting snug against the plate, her arms stretched straight up. Her ankles wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ring fixed directly onto a heavy iron plate bolted flat to the riveted iron wall just above the floor on its own side, the cuffs sitting snug against the plate, her feet shoulder-width apart.

Pose: standing with her back pressed flat against the riveted iron wall, facing the camera, her arms stretched straight up with her hands hanging limp and loose from the cuffs, her bare feet shoulder-width apart flat on the floor, her head tipped slightly forward, her whole body sagging with fatigue, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.

Footwear: bare feet flat on the floor, the soles, toes and tops of her feet streaked with soot and dirt.

Background & Lighting: the dim light catching the painted pattern in sharp glints, carving every fold and curve.

Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide. portrait 2:3 vertical.
